claim: Flat-rate plans do not need an annual commitment to get the best available rates. Plans are purchased for the current month's billing period and automatically renew until canceled; when you cancel a plan, flat-rate pricing continues through the end of the current billing cycle, and the distribution and its plan resources then switch to pay-as-you-go pricing at the start of the next billing cycle.

evidence.quote: Plans do not need an annual commitment to get the best available rates.
Plans are purchased for the current month’s billing period and automatically renew until canceled.
Your distribution and all associated plan resources will then switch to pay-as-you-go pricing at the start of the next billing cycle.
When you cancel a plan, you'll maintain your flat-rate pricing through the end of your current billing cycle.
